ours.said: 8 providers, EVERY ONE has a when: table 'default, read-mostly' · data-grid 'sort / filter / select / edit-in-place is required' · list-items '≤ 3 fields per item, tappable' · transaction-row 'the records are a ledger with a running balance' · document-row 'the records are issued documents to open / download' · standing-order-mandate-row 'the records are future recurring instructions' · timeline 'time is the structure, records have happened' · tree 'records nest'
ours.note: ADOPTED s252-D1. CANON — cited, not redone. #270 already proposed the meta copy for table / data-grid / list-items.

ours.said: 12 providers each with a when, gated by the five intent words on the answers axis (chart-intents.json, s251-D11): comparison · change-over-time · distribution · relationship · composition
ours.note: CANON. roles.json itself flags this as 'the call most worth striking if you disagree — see §14 call 1'. chart-sparkline and Chart-bullet are NOT in this provider list; their whens live on their metas and in headline-metric.

ours.said: stat-card 'default — label · value · delta · period, no series' · kpi-tile 'a series exists to show (s247-D3 / DP-08: no series ⇒ not a KPI tile)' · Chart-bullet 'a target or performance band is the point, not the delta' · runway-bar 'the number is "money vs what is already scheduled"'

status-indicator 'one state, one dot + label, 2–4 cols' · summary 'n × count as a key/value list, 6–12 cols' · meter 'the threshold is a cap being spent against (limits-meter reading)' · badge 'inline, attached to another element, count only'

26 of the 45 components in this slice already carry a machine-shaped `when` on the meta (all 14 charts, stat-card, kpi-tile, runway-bar, summary, status-indicator, legend, and the record-list trio via #270)
ours.note: MEASURED. The gap in slice B is NOT the charts — it is the container/identity family: cards, account-card, accordion, carousel, pagination, filter-toolbar-bar, view-options, tags, avatar, avatar-group, amount-display, stats-band-lockup, payment-card-visual, qr-code, limits-meter.
